referenceNotes.fr: Le plan mariage fixe les portes en bois et la brique ; GA05 sert au médium.
referenceNotes.en: Wedding frame fixes wood doors and brick facade; GA05 is medium only.

prompt: Render a professional film continuity reference sheet, entirely hand-painted WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. Use the final illustrated reference for PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: broad visible brush planes, transparent washes, dry edges, warm reserved paper, selective precise construction lines. Photographic references determine geometry and object construction. This is a convincing hand-painted artwork, not a photograph with a filter, not 3D, not glossy anime.  Exactly THREE equal vertical panels in a single landscape 16:9 sheet, with narrow clean warm-paper gutters. No captions, no letters, no labels, no people, no silhouettes, no faces in portraits, no shoes, no vehicles newer than the period. One coherent location across the panels; perspective changes must preserve architectural landmarks.  Subject: the exact circa-1978 town-hall/community-building wedding doorway in photographic reference1 with the couple REMOVED. Tall honey-brown paneled wooden double doors with upper glass, right leaf open into warm interior, modest stone threshold and shallow stoop, weathered tan/brown brick facade, period bronze door knob. Urban Bronx street context on LEFT, brick tenements and one simple dark streetlamp, warm late afternoon sun. LEFT: empty doorway frontal/three-quarter establishing view like reference1. CENTER: wider sidewalk view giving street and brick facade context while retaining door proportions. RIGHT: close low view of paneled door base, bronze hinge, stone threshold and stoop wear. No people, flowers, wedding dress, signs, text, fantasy architecture or modern glass tower.

qa.fr: Double porte et seuil cohérents ; même axe répété plutôt qu’un vrai plan de rue très large.
qa.en: Coherent double door and threshold; repeats a similar axis rather than a very wide street view.
